task.title: Access the Magnetic Field FFT dB
task.shortdesc: This section describes the process of accessing the magnetic field FFT graph.

context.p: This section describes the process of accessing the magnetic field FFT graph.
To access the Magnetic Field FFT dB through the application:

step.cmd: Select the location associated with the motor.
From the subsequent screens, select the corresponding process, plant, and motor name.
Tap Select Vibration to select Magnetic field FFT dB.
Tap Select Date and Select Time to select the date and time corresponding to the moment of the installation.

info.p: You should see the corresponding waveform as shown in Figure 36. placeholder

step.cmd: Click DATA DOWNLOADto download the generated data.
